entities.span: Tracer Bullet: stand up the thinnest real thread first (a real session, a real read, real isolation), then thicken with record and replay, on demand mints, commands, and CI.

Scaffold Vitest as two projects: a unit project (jsdom only where a test renders a component) and an integration project (`node`). Point the unit project at colocated `src/**/*.test.ts` and the integration project at `test/integration/**`. Alias `server-only` to an empty module, resolve `@/` with `vite-tsconfig-paths`, load `.env.test`, and install the in memory Sentry transport in the setup file. Add `pnpm test` as `vitest run`, satisfies **AC-5**, **AC-10**
rejected_spans: because `@t3-oss/env-nextjs` will not hand a server variable to code it believes runs on the client

entities.span: Re-mint the fixture pool in `supabase/seed.sql` with valid version 4 UUIDs, keeping the three user shapes (dev one and dev two with profiles, dev three with none). The old `1111…` and `2222…` rows must be deleted earlier in the same file than the new rows are inserted. Tighten the profile parser from `z.guid()` to `z.uuid()`, satisfies **AC-4**, **AC-6**
rejected_spans: because `auth.users.email` is unique and the new pool reuses the addresses

entities.span: Give `createClient()` in `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` an optional cookie adapter, defaulting to the `next/headers` store it reads today. No existing caller changes and no behaviour changes
rejected_spans: so a test can drive the application's own client with an in memory jar

entities.span: Build the development only session mint under `test/helpers/`, guarded by `DEV_SESSION_ENABLED`, using the admin magiclink exchange into an in memory cookie jar passed to `createClient()`. Verify the exact Supabase auth API surface against current docs at build time (per the supabase skill), satisfies **AC-3**
Write the isolation integration test: mint as dev one, write, mint as dev two, prove isolation, against the local stack and through `createClient()`, satisfies **AC-1**

Build the bespoke record and replay recorder with an explicit record mode, replay from `test/fixtures/<service>/`, redaction at write time, and record the GitHub stand in response. Add `test/fixtures/` to `.prettierignore` in the same step, satisfies **AC-2**, **AC-8**, **AC-9**, **AC-13**
Build the on demand fixture user mint helper for fresh per test users, satisfies **AC-11**
Split the commands: `pnpm test` for unit, `pnpm test:integration` for integration with a clear error when the stack is down, satisfies **AC-12**
Add the CI test job that runs `supabase start` in Docker, then unit and integration, satisfies **AC-7**
